description:
MERIT Golf makes tour-quality golf balls designed for competitive junior golfers.  Our target customers are golfers ages 0-17 who play regularly and competitively.  Our product is built with the same high-quality materials and processes as the big-brand balls professional golfers use.  They're even made in the same factory!

Junior golfers have a slower swing speed. The top selling golf balls were designed for the powerful swings of adult golfers.  Our golf balls are designed to give skilled young golfers the same advantage that a premium ball gives an adult golfer.

We've tested our product on the course and in the laboratory.  MERIT golf balls fly further, and spin faster for slower swing speeds. This means longer drives and better loft and control from irons around the green.

We have two models, the M1 and the M1s (for soft).  We generally recommend the M1s for younger golfers who have swing speeds UNDER 80 mph, and the M1 for golfers who are stronger, more experienced, and swinging between 80-95 mph. By comparison, PGA tour players are swinging ~95mph for women, and ~115 for men.

At MERIT our brand is supportive of both kid golfers and their parents. We were founded by a young competitive golfer (Stephen) and his father (Sean), so we understand the committment for both parents and kids to compete in this game. We like to say, "We're here for the bogeys and the birdeys" on the golfer's journey. Our tone is encouraging..."do your best", not "be the best". Our balls have alignment arrows on them with encouraging phrases like "Focus" and "Earn It". We want to help them get better, and we believe our product helps them do that.

Payment terms: Payment through PayPal
